checklist_items.title: Python Basics — Data Types và Control Flow
checklist_items.description: int, float, str, list, tuple, dict, set, bool, None; if/elif/else, for/while, break/continue/pass; list comprehensions
checklist_items.market_relevance: Python là ngôn ngữ phổ biến nhất cho AI/ML và scripting

checklist_items.title: Functions và OOP
checklist_items.description: def, *args/**kwargs, lambda, decorators (@), classes, __init__, inheritance, super(), dunder methods, dataclasses
checklist_items.market_relevance: OOP là paradigm cốt lõi của Python development

checklist_items.title: Error Handling và Context Managers
checklist_items.description: try/except/else/finally, custom exceptions, raise, with statement, context managers (__enter__/__exit__), contextlib
checklist_items.market_relevance: Proper error handling là production requirement

checklist_items.title: Iterators, Generators, Comprehensions
checklist_items.description: iter/next protocol, generator functions (yield), generator expressions, list/dict/set comprehensions, zip, enumerate, map/filter
checklist_items.market_relevance: Generators là key tool cho memory-efficient Python code

checklist_items.title: File I/O và Standard Library
checklist_items.description: open(), pathlib.Path, json, csv, datetime, collections (Counter, defaultdict, deque), itertools, functools, typing
checklist_items.market_relevance: Standard library giảm dependency phức tạp

checklist_items.title: Virtual Environments và Package Management
checklist_items.description: venv, pip, requirements.txt, pyproject.toml, poetry, uv (modern), virtual environment best practices
checklist_items.market_relevance: Dependency isolation là thiết yếu cho Python projects

checklist_items.title: Async Python — asyncio
checklist_items.description: async def, await, asyncio.gather, asyncio.create_task, aiohttp, asyncio.Queue, event loop management
checklist_items.market_relevance: Async Python thiết yếu cho FastAPI và high-performance apps

checklist_items.title: Type Hints và mypy
checklist_items.description: PEP 484 type hints, Optional, Union, List, Dict, Callable, TypeVar, Protocol, dataclasses, Pydantic, mypy type checking
checklist_items.market_relevance: Type hints là standard trong modern Python development

checklist_items.title: Testing với pytest
checklist_items.description: pytest basics, fixtures, parametrize, markers, monkeypatch, mock (unittest.mock), coverage, conftest.py
checklist_items.market_relevance: pytest là standard testing framework cho Python

checklist_items.title: Decorators và Metaclasses
checklist_items.description: Function decorators, class decorators, decorator factories (với arguments), functools.wraps, property, staticmethod, classmethod
checklist_items.market_relevance: Decorators dùng rộng rãi trong frameworks (Flask, FastAPI, pytest)

checklist_items.title: Concurrency — Threads và Processes
checklist_items.description: threading, multiprocessing, concurrent.futures (ThreadPool/ProcessPool), GIL understanding, queue.Queue, Semaphore
checklist_items.market_relevance: Concurrency thiết yếu cho Python backend performance

checklist_items.title: Web APIs — FastAPI / Flask
checklist_items.description: FastAPI basics (already covered in fastapi skill), Flask micro-framework, Blueprints, app factory pattern, deployment với gunicorn
checklist_items.market_relevance: Web framework skills là core Python backend skill

checklist_items.title: Data Processing — Pandas và NumPy
checklist_items.description: DataFrame operations, Series, indexing, groupby, merge/join, NumPy arrays, broadcasting, vectorization
checklist_items.market_relevance: Pandas/NumPy là bắt buộc cho data science Python

checklist_items.title: Database với SQLAlchemy
checklist_items.description: ORM models, sessions, relationships, migrations với Alembic, async SQLAlchemy, Prisma Python alternative
checklist_items.market_relevance: SQLAlchemy là ORM phổ biến nhất cho Python

checklist_items.title: Environment và Configuration Management
checklist_items.description: python-dotenv, pydantic-settings, configparser, environment-specific settings, secrets management

checklist_items.title: Performance Optimization
checklist_items.description: cProfile, line_profiler, memory_profiler, Cython, numba, C extensions, PyPy, avoiding common pitfalls
checklist_items.market_relevance: Performance optimization là advanced Python skill

checklist_items.title: Packaging và Distribution
checklist_items.description: pyproject.toml (PEP 517/518), setuptools, wheel, twine, PyPI publishing, namespace packages, entry_points
checklist_items.market_relevance: Package publishing là skill cho open source contributors

checklist_items.title: Docker và Production Deployment
checklist_items.description: Multi-stage Dockerfile, gunicorn workers, health checks, non-root user, environment variables, monitoring
